notes.title: Escape from Life Inc is coming to Xbox, PS4/PS5 & Nintendo Switch on March 31!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I know it’s been quiet lately, but I’m finally here to announce the console release!

Thanks to a small porting company called [url=https://www.sometimesyou.com/consoles/porting.html]Sometimes You[/url] the game will soon be available on Xbox, Playstation and Nintendo Switch! It’s always been a dream of mine to have a game on a Nintendo console… super cool to see it actually happen!

Anyways, you can already pre-order it on [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/escape-from-life-inc/9mzt8nxdfmxn?activetab=pivot:overviewtab]Xbox[/url] and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/escape-from-life-inc-switch/]Switch[/url] and get a 20% discount! It’s $7.99 now and the full launch price will be $9.99.

Also, you can try it out now on Switch as a free demo, plus there’s a free trial version available on Xbox!

If you haven’t played the game yet, well, this might be a good opportunity to do so :)

notes.notes:

notes.title: New Little Secret & 15% Off on the Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I’ve just pushed a new update to Steam & Itch! Other than some boring bug fixes, there’s a bit of new content…

I’ve finally added a reward for collecting all the yellow fruits! So now you can go open that big door in Rock Bottom. Don’t expect much, it’s just a fun little easter egg :D

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36348525/e4d02c766338d5d58ba9d5061c7dcc8cfba0f5c8.png[/img]

In other news, the game is now 15% off on Itch.io as part of the Summer Sale! I can’t participate in Steam’s sadly, they require you to wait some time after launch before joining a sale.

Oh, and that postmortem is coming, it’s just taking a while to write :)

notes.title: Escape from Life Inc is out now!🐟🦅🦌
notes.notes:
After about one and a half years in development, it’s finally out! You can grab a copy for $6.99, either on Itch.io or right here on Steam!

If you just found the game, check out the trailer to see what it’s all about :D

[previewyoutube=cgIiviGxWdU;full][/previewyoutube]

I’ll be sure to make a proper postmortem in about a month, showing the entire development story, what I learned from it, and of course the revenue!

In the meantime though… Enjoy the game! I hope you like this weird little world I’ve created :P
